## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector participation in cyclicals/defensives (Comm., Consumer Stpl., Industrials positive) versus clear Technology weakness, and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); signals mixed so neutral stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication lead: VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples strong: PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, CL (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.65%) ABOVE TREND. Industrials strong: FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, UPS (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +10.77%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.25% | 1M: -29.37%) BELOW TREND. Financials soft: PYPL (1W: -24.87% | 1M: -33.29%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -7.88% | 1M: -7.57%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -13.10% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +16.71% | 1M: +6.13%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). Style: Cyclical/Value tilt.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMAT (1W: -10.94% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -11.26% | 1M: -27.74%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -12.08% | 1M: -31.03%) BELOW TREND, BKNG (1W: -13.10% | 1M: -16.92%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -13.53% | 1M: -32.68%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Technology names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: VZ (1W: +18.31%), CHTR (1W: +16.71%), FDX (1W: +13.76%), PEP (1W: +12.67%), DOW (1W: +12.67%). Note major divergence: AMAT (1W: -10.94% | 1M: +2.70%) CORRECTION, GOOGL (1W: -2.07% | 1M: +5.38%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -9.22% | 1M: +1.45%) CORRECTION — three large-cap divergences; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology shows pronounced weakness and dispersion; NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND. Tech breadth: 3/19 positive — sector under pressure, selective opportunities only.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed to soft: JPM (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY, V (1W: -0.80% | 1M: -7.95%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +1.50% | 1M: -4.76%) RECOVERY. Financials breadth: 6/20 positive — watch for selective reversals rather than broad leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare showing defensive pockets: JNJ (1W: +4.62% | 1M: +16.11%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare breadth: 9/15 positive — mixed, but MRK/JNJ/PFE providing stability; monitor UNH regulatory risk.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor cyclicals/value exposure (FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +19.91%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.96% | 1M: +20.68%) ABOVE TREND) and consumer staples (PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND). Reduce exposure to pressured mega-cap Technology (NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -17.73%) BELOW TREND). Style: Cyclical/Value tilt within a neutral regime; stay selective given tech divergences.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND — news confirmed; AAPL (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment/earnings momentum; APD (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +9.73%) ABOVE TREND — contract wins. BEARISH: UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND — regulatory headlines; EL (1W: -16.10% | 1M: -10.95%) BELOW TREND — weak outlook; PYPL (1W: -24.87% | 1M: -33.29%) BELOW TREND — continued downside risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Staples (10/12 positive), Industrials (9/13 positive), Materials (5/7 positive) — breadth and headlines supportive. BEARISH: Technology (3/19 positive), Financials (6/20 positive), Consumer Discretionary (4/11 positive) — monitor extension of selling.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -10.72% | 1M: -8.20%) BELOW TREND — watch failure to recover recent 1M lows as confirmation of deeper correction. AAPL (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND — watch hold of this week’s gains for broader tech stabilization. JPM (1W: +1.22% | 1M: -7.31%) RECOVERY — watch follow-through above this week’s high for financials rotation. PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND — monitor profit-taking after sharp run.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MRK (+80): Merck ENFLONSIA approval; price confirming — MRK (1W: +10.53% | 1M: +9.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. AAPL (+55): Biggest iPhone quarter; price confirming — AAPL (1W: +6.83% | 1M: +5.16%) ABOVE TREND — accumulation. APD (+55): NASA contract; price confirming — APD (1W: +10.73% | 1M: +9.73%) ABOVE TREND.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-75): DOJ probe headlines; price confirming — UNH (1W: -8.12% | 1M: -23.04%) BELOW TREND. EL (-60): Weak outlook headlines; price confirming — EL (1W: -16.10% | 1M: -10.95%) BELOW TREND. PEP (-50): price/sentiment divergence — PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND, news warrants monitoring for margin pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a cyclical/value tilt given broad participation in Industrials, Materials and Consumer Staples. Stocks showing relative strength include VZ (1W: +18.31% | 1M: +18.90%) ABOVE TREND, FDX (1W: +13.76% | 1M: +18.20%) ABOVE TREND, PEP (1W: +12.67% | 1M: +20.56%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: pronounced Tech divergences (AMAT, GOOGL, META CORRECTIONs) and headline-driven healthcare/financial calls (UNH regulatory, MRK approval) — watch for trend confirmation.
